sourceFile: 4.1 BRS-161016(DT)Summary + Detail report TEST new JIG improve use new dry machine 2024.04.09_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable validation evidence but misidentifies the changed factor and includes many spurious extracted outcomes.
issues: Changed factor is a noisy list of row labels rather than the tested new dry machine/improved jig condition.
Baseline or comparator condition is not explicit, so baseline vs test framing is unsupported.
Dry time, date, test round, morning/afternoon, and sheet dates are mixed instead of preserved as subgroup keys.
Many outcomes are header/temperature/time extraction artifacts, not real performance results.
Some numeric subresults appear internally inconsistent or duplicated from summary/detail rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the primary factor be new dry machine, improved jig after repair, dry time setting, or a combined validation condition?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor from purpose/content rows as a concise tested condition with no invented baseline.
Use date/sheet, dry time, trial round, and morning/afternoon only as subgroup context.
Keep only real outcome domains: jig press glue-not-dry NG, main-line suspension separation NG, and tension force if in report scope.
Remove header-derived statistical measurements and duplicate summary/detail artifacts.
Recheck all input/OK/NG/rate values against cited result rows before approval.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient because grouping and metric citations are misaligned.
